projectDescription: Loop is a TypeScript library that carries normalized packets between inputs (keyboard, gamepad, MIDI) and outputs, with a RAF-driven runtime, type-checked pipelines, reactive value handles, and a cross-device relay layer.
keyFeatures: Normalized packet contract with three kinds: value (number/Vec), frame (ImageData), and data (tagged JSON/text)
Compile-time type-checked pipelines via loop.pipe() — kind and data-type mismatches throw at wiring time, not runtime
Reactive Handle<T> with RAF-driven polling, push-based on('change') subscriptions, and DOM bind()
Built-in input sources: keyboard text, D-pad (keyboard + gamepad), sliders (gamepad left-stick + MIDI CC), MIDI CC
Cross-device relay with BroadcastChannel (same-machine, multi-tab) and WebSocket transports
Zero-render philosophy: Loop never renders anything — it only carries packets from source to sink
Works as a plain <script type='module'> in the browser with no build step required
RAF-driven runtime with automatic start/stop, Node.js-compatible setTimeout fallback
publicApiSurface: loop.component(def) — auto-dispatch to source/transform/sink based on def shape
loop.pipe(...stages) — wire stages into a type-checked Pipeline
loop.input(name) — get a Handle for a named input ('keyboard' | 'dpad')
loop.output(name) — get a stub sink for a named output
loop.tick(fn) — register a per-frame callback, returns unsubscribe fn
loop.getSlidersInput() — returns SliderBundle { x, y, rotation } as Handle<number> each
loop.relay.clear() — disconnect and clear all relay rooms
RelayRoom.subscribe<T>(initial) — returns a Handle<T> updated by transport
RelayRoom.outbound(opts) — sink Stage that sends packets over transport
RelayRoom.inbound(opts) — source Stage that reads latest received packet
Handle<T>.on('change', fn) — subscribe to changes, returns unsubscribe fn
Handle<T>.bind(el, apply) — bind to a DOM element with an apply callback
